title: Richmond Recreation Attendance
description: Program registration history, membership/facility drop-in scans, and activity outcome records from City of Richmond Recreation.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this JSON file was generated.

period.description: Portfolio coverage window: earliest membership scan through generation time.

start.description: Earliest membership scan timestamp from Attendance-Membership Scanning.csv (America/Vancouver local time as ISO 8601 with offset).

end.description: Generation time (now) when this JSON was produced; matches meta.generatedAt.

programHistory.description: Registered-and-attended programs from Attendance-History.csv (status Booked only). No timestamps.

membershipScans.description: Drop-in / facility access scans from Attendance-Membership Scanning.csv.

activityOutcomes.description: Activity-Outcomes paste: eventId, activity, createdDate only.

personInformation.description: Optional MyRichmond Client Information paste. Only First Name, Last Name, Birthdate; Account and Age discarded.

sourceRowNumber.description: Original RowNumber from the CSV export.

timeAttended.description: Local America/Vancouver wall time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss (no offset).

facility.description: Facility name (first Name column in the CSV).

membershipPass.description: Membership or pass used (second Name column in the CSV).

sourceRowNumber.description: Original RowNumber from the CSV export.

activityOutcomeItem.description: One Activity-Outcomes row: eventId, activity, createdDate.

eventId.description: Event Id (string to preserve leading zeros).

activity.description: Activity name, e.g. SWIM - SWIMMER 3 - CHILDREN.

createdDate.description: Created Date as YYYY-MM-DD (source uses M/D/YY).
